title: Ayushman Bharat Scheme (Launched: 28 September 2018):
summary: Ayushman Bharat Scheme (Launched: 28 September 2018): — Flagship scheme comprehensively covered in the Government Schemes Consolidated Masterfile.

blocks.title: 🏛️ Canonical Reference & Masterfile Integration
blocks.text: This flagship scheme is comprehensively detailed in the Government Schemes Masterfile (Section: "migrated-schemes-masterfile"). Key highlights and parameters are summarized below.

items: Ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Beneficiaries: BPL families, unorganized sector laborers.
Coverage: Health insurance of Rs. 5 lakh for over 55 crore people (12 crore families).
Health and Wellness Centres: 1.5 lakh centres to provide primary healthcare.
Ayushman Bhava Abhiyan (Sept 2023): Promotes health services in rural areas.
From September 2024: Additional Rs. 5 lakh insurance for elderly (70+ years).
Telemedicine and Digital Health Records under Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission.
The scheme aims to provide affordable healthcare, reduce out-of-pocket expenses, and
improve access to quality medical services.
